candidate.title: Newly added booking attendees are not synced to the existing external calendar event (stale attendee list passed to updateCalendarAttendees)
reports: [bug] the booking row is updated with createmany of attendees but the new attendee emails are never pushed to the existing calendar event attendees before eventmanager.updatecalendarattendees, and guests already present on the booking's calendar entry are not reconciled with the evt attendee list ordering. depending on eventmanager.updatecalendarattendees semantics, the calendar event can be rebuilt with an attendee list that includes the just-created db rows, so any failure between the prisma update and the calendar update leaves the database and the external calendar event permanently out of sync (attendees on the booking but not invited on the calendar event), with no rollback of the created attendee rows.
